tools.name: search_tools
tools.description: Search published, reviewed catalogue entries by task or name. Cite listing URLs. Not exhaustive; no held drafts, AI generation or paid ranking.

tools.name: get_tool
tools.description: Get one public listing, pricing evidence, dates and sponsorship disclosure. Does not freshly verify vendor claims.

tools.name: compare_tools
tools.description: Retrieve up to three public listings side by side. Do not invent ratings, prices or recommendations.

tools.name: check_tool_listing
tools.description: Check a public website for existing published listings before submitting. Does not reveal private pending submissions.

tools.name: validate_tool_submission
tools.description: Validate the same fields as the website without saving. Returns a new idempotency key. Show all details and the private email to the user before calling submit_tool.

tools.name: get_submission_status
tools.description: Retrieve only your submission status using its private receipt and tracking secret. Never reveal or request other inbox records.

findings.title: Description issues instructions to the model
findings.detail: Description of "validate_tool_submission" contains imperative instructions directed at the AI assistant rather than describing the tool. This is the core tool-poisoning technique.

findings.remediation: Treat the server as untrusted; the model may obey embedded instructions.

findings.title: Description references secrets/credentials
findings.detail: Description of "submit_tool" references sensitive artifacts (secret). A tool description has no reason to mention credentials.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: search_tools, get_submission_status · Private data: check_tool_listing, validate_tool_submission, submit_tool, get_submission_status · Public sink: validate_tool_submission, submit_tool.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: search_tools, get_submission_status · Private data: check_tool_listing, validate_tool_submission, submit_tool, get_submission_status · Public sink: validate_tool_submission, submit_tool

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
